name: Cascade Biotech Life-Sign Earring
description:
A small, stud-style earring with an embedded vital-sign monitor that tracks heart rate, blood pressure, and cortisol levels. The earring communicates via short-range encrypted signal to a paired device. A tiny LED on the earring's surface pulses with the wearer's heartbeat — invisible in daylight, faintly visible in darkness.

Originally designed for patients in post-operative monitoring, the Life-Sign Earring has been adopted by couples, close-knit teams, and protective parents who want real-time confirmation that someone they care about is still alive.
functionality: Real-time vital monitoring, heartbeat LED, encrypted data transmission
what_it_says: Someone is watching your heartbeat right now, and you chose to let them.
story_hooks: A Life-Sign Earring begins transmitting flatline data from someone who was confirmed alive thirty seconds ago — either the earring malfunctioned or something stopped a heart in half a minute.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Pulse Carbine PC-6 'Heartbeat'
